description: Department of Local Governor, Central Province - Imposed Entertainment Tax in Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawata Korale PS area
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily concerns the imposition of an entertainment tax, which involves the creation of a regulatory framework and compliance requirements for recreational activities. It references specific tax ordinances and amendment acts (Entertainment Tax Ordinance, Entertainment Tax Amendment Act), making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel/structure change or any other specialized category.
